summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Apollo Builders MVP. Backend pytest 5/5 passing (health, enquiry create valid, invalid email 422, empty name 422, list persistence with no _id leak). Frontend Playwright tests: all navigation, home sections (hero, trust-points-row with 4 items, gallery, featured-projects with all 6 projects, why-us, process, editorial-marquee, faq-section with 7 accordions, testimonials, final-cta), services page + kitchen-renovations sub-slug, contact-page, contact form end-to-end (fills, submits, `thanks` state and 'Enquiry sent' toast appear), and mobile nav toggle all PASS.

issues: Empty-form submission is blocked by native HTML5 required attribute before custom toast 'Please complete the required fields.' can fire. Not a crash — acceptable UX, but reviewer note: custom validation toast is unreachable via UI for missing name/phone/email/message/project_type since the browser stops submission first. Consider removing `required` attributes or using noValidate to surface the custom toast consistently.

critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx: form fields have HTML5 `required` which pre-empts the custom toast validation branch — either remove required or add noValidate on the <form> if the custom toast is intended UX.
server.py: enquiry model uses EmailStr (good); MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection in list_enquiries.
Resend stub path works — health reports 'stubbed' and email_sent=false as expected.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed enquiries via API and via UI submission.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py — run via `pytest backend/tests/test_api.py`. Preview URL: https://premium-apollo.preview.emergentagent.com. Resend key intentionally empty; email_provider='stubbed', email_sent=false is correct.
